A is clearer about what to keep, but its closing test checks whether people guess the business is a bakery, which doesn't measure what makes this one different. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B is better overall. It ties each element in the description to a specific cause of the generic look, and it gives a more thorough small-size and one-color stress test (32 px, reversed, cropped avatar).
